router_note: A Cloudflare Worker in front of the two Pages projects must send person slugs to this site and keep card slugs on the existing Next.js /birth-card pages until those hubs move to /card/.

presidents_isolated.note: US presidents birth-card set is isolated under /presidents. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

holidays_isolated.note: US federal holiday birth-card set is isolated under /holidays. Fixed § 6103(a) dates only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

nobel_isolated.note: Nobel laureate birth-card set is isolated under /nobel. Day-precision Nobel API dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

scotus_isolated.note: Current SCOTUS justices birth-card set is isolated under /scotus. Day-precision SCOTUS.gov dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

parks_isolated.note: US National Park birth-card set is isolated under /parks. Dates are Wikipedia National Park establishment, not first monument.

cabinet_isolated.note: Current US Cabinet birth-card set is isolated under /cabinet. VP + 15 secretaries only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

senators_isolated.note: Current US senators birth-card set is isolated under /senators. 100 seats; day-precision Bioguide + Wikipedia + Wikidata P569 must match. Path-split is not activated.

governors_isolated.note: Current US governors birth-card set is isolated under /governors. 50 states only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

signers_isolated.note: Declaration signers birth-card set is isolated under /signers. Verified subset only. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes.

olympics_winter_isolated.note: Winter Olympic multiple-medalist birth-card set is isolated under /olympics/winter. Wikipedia 8+ list + infobox dates verified against Wikidata P569. It must not take celebrity person slugs or live card-meaning routes. Path-split is not activated.
